verdict.rationale: Supabase documents its own programmatic surfaces for most of this flow. The Management API manages organizations and projects programmatically, the MCP server lets agents query databases and manage migrations, and the CLI handles local project setup and schema migration files. Runtime probes confirm the CLI runs from npm and the hosted MCP endpoint is live with an OAuth flow. missing for 10: explicit evidence that an agent can fetch the connection string via API/CLI/MCP, explicit documentation of creating a hosted project through the API or MCP (only implied by 'manage projects'), and independent hands-on corroboration of a full end-to-end agent provisioning run.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can provision a database end to end — create it, fetch the connection string, apply schema, and run queries — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching the dashboard
